concepts.title: Risk Occurrence
concepts.authored_definition: An actual occurrence or change relevant to a risk scenario; a scenario or report alone does not establish that it happened.
concepts.rationale: Retain the actuality boundary. Riskium requires an actual occurrence supported in context; a source entry permitting a potential event does not establish realization.
concepts.boundary: A scenario alone is not evidence that its occurrence happened.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported reinspection of selected primary passages and unchanged authored/local structural context; not an independent expert judgment.

concepts.title: Risk Source
concepts.authored_definition: A contextual source role that an entity may play in giving rise to risk, alone or with other contributors. The catalog boundary spans possible bearer categories and is not assigned a single OntoUML stereotype here.
concepts.rationale: Retain a bounded analogy. Riskium allows heterogeneous contextual contributors and opportunity perspectives; the security-specific source does not supply that whole cross-category profile.
concepts.boundary: Do not assign one universal stereotype or a formal subsumption from a matching label.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported reinspection of selected primary passages and unchanged authored/local structural context; not an independent expert judgment.

concepts.title: Predisposing Condition
concepts.authored_definition: A risk-relevant situation that increases susceptibility to specified occurrences or effects. Reference to it requires explicit source support and does not establish a causal mechanism.
concepts.rationale: Retain the comparison with an explicit direction boundary. The authored Riskium situation increases susceptibility, whereas the inspected source allows likelihood changes in either direction.
concepts.boundary: The comparison does not establish a causal mechanism or justify silently broadening the authored definition.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported reinspection of selected primary passages and unchanged authored/local structural context; not an independent expert judgment.

concepts.title: Trigger
concepts.authored_definition: An actual occurrence interpreted as initiating a risk-relevant development in a specified context. A hypothetical trigger description is represented as scenario content, not as an actual Trigger individual.
concepts.rationale: Retain the actuality and initiation boundary. A Riskium Trigger is actual and initiating in its context; the compared potential-event entry alone supplies neither commitment.
concepts.boundary: A hypothetical trigger remains scenario content.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported reinspection of selected primary passages and unchanged authored/local structural context; not an independent expert judgment.

concepts.title: Consequence
concepts.authored_definition: An outcome relevant to objectives, considered as a referent distinct from a statement about it. Outcomes can have different ontological categories; no universal event or object stereotype is asserted.
concepts.rationale: Replace the scoped absence label with a positive comparison boundary: Riskium Consequence is an objective-relevant outcome referent, distinct from the compared potential event. No universal absence claim is made.
concepts.boundary: An outcome must not be identified with an event description merely because both occur in a source record.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported reinspection of selected primary passages and unchanged authored/local structural context; not an independent expert judgment.

concepts.title: Vulnerability
concepts.authored_definition: An intrinsic susceptibility of a bearer to specified risk-relevant conditions or effects. The proposed mode interpretation requires a supported bearer; security-specific exploitation meanings remain source-qualified.
concepts.rationale: Retain the security comparison and identify Mode separately as a modeling foundation. The current intrinsic-susceptibility interpretation requires a supported bearer; exactly-one characterization is distinct from a documentary weakness report.
concepts.boundary: Neither shared terminology nor the type annotation supplies actual bearer evidence or independent semantic acceptance.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported reinspection of selected primary passages and unchanged authored/local structural context; not an independent expert judgment.

concepts.title: Exposure
concepts.authored_definition: A time-qualified situation relating an affected bearer to a risk source or relevant condition. An exposure score or its description is information about that situation.
concepts.rationale: Retain the bounded exposure analogy. The authored Riskium referent is a time-qualified bearer/source situation; the inspected security discussion does not itself define that formal situation model.
concepts.boundary: An exposure value is information about the situation, not the situation itself.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported reinspection of selected primary passages and unchanged authored/local structural context; not an independent expert judgment.

concepts.title: Risk State
concepts.authored_definition: A temporally qualified state of a risk-relevant situation, distinct from the workflow status of its record.
concepts.rationale: Replace the scoped absence label with a contrast. Riskium explicitly individuates a temporally qualified risk situation; generic entity description does not supply its state identity or a workflow interpretation.
concepts.boundary: A record workflow status must not be substituted for the state of the risk-relevant situation.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported reinspection of selected primary passages and unchanged authored/local structural context; not an independent expert judgment.

concepts.title: Information Content
concepts.authored_definition: The abstract informational meaning expressed by artifacts or versions. Content identity requires an explicit equivalence policy and is not inferred from equal strings or file hashes.
concepts.rationale: Retain conceptual-entity context without importing a content identity policy. Riskium keeps abstract meaning separate from artifacts and versions and requires its own explicit equivalence criteria.
concepts.boundary: Equal strings or file digests alone do not establish content identity.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported reinspection of selected primary passages and unchanged authored/local structural context; not an independent expert judgment.

concepts.title: Entry Revision
concepts.authored_definition: An identifiable version of a register entry, preserving the content and qualified links effective at its issue.
concepts.rationale: Retain the object/derivation distinction. Riskium EntryRevision is a version object with effective links; a qualified revision describes derivation rather than being that version or its creation activity.
concepts.boundary: Do not substitute a derivation qualification for an entry-version individual.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported reinspection of selected primary passages and unchanged authored/local structural context; not an independent expert judgment.

concepts.title: Assessment Activity
concepts.authored_definition: An actual activity contributing to risk identification, analysis or evaluation. It may cover only part of a risk assessment; the complete standardized assessment process is outside the current process-modeling scope.
concepts.rationale: Retain the activity/process scope distinction. A Riskium AssessmentActivity may contribute only one actual part of identification, analysis or evaluation; it is not automatically the complete security assessment process.
concepts.boundary: A planned assessment is not an actual assessment activity.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported reinspection of selected primary passages and unchanged authored/local structural context; not an independent expert judgment.

concepts.title: Treatment Activity
concepts.authored_definition: An actual performance of actions intended to modify or otherwise respond to risk, distinct from the plan describing them.
concepts.rationale: Retain the response analogy and separate actual treatment performance from its plan. Intended risk modification does not by itself establish observed effectiveness.
concepts.boundary: A documented plan alone does not establish an executed treatment.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported reinspection of selected primary passages and unchanged authored/local structural context; not an independent expert judgment.

concepts.title: Risk Control
concepts.authored_definition: A contextual measure intended to maintain or modify risk. A policy, device, practice or activity may serve as its bearer. Implementation and observed effectiveness are separate claims; one cross-category stereotype is not asserted.
concepts.rationale: Retain the security-control analogy as one contextual use of Riskium RiskControl. The authored profile permits different bearer categories and separates implementation from effectiveness.
concepts.boundary: A named or installed measure alone is not proof of effectiveness; no cross-category stereotype is forced.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported reinspection of selected primary passages and unchanged authored/local structural context; not an independent expert judgment.

concepts.title: Responsibility Relator
concepts.authored_definition: A temporally qualified responsibility relationship connecting its participants, responsibility scope and grounding assignment.
concepts.rationale: Retain Relator as a modeling foundation rather than an external responsibility definition. Riskium adds grounding, temporal scope and responsibility semantics; its distinct-participant identity rule is additional to the C2 minimum-cardinality sum.
concepts.boundary: An owner name alone does not establish a grounded mandate or distinct mediated participants; independent judgment remains #23.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported reinspection of selected primary passages and unchanged authored/local structural context; not an independent expert judgment.

concepts.title: Workflow Scheme Version
concepts.authored_definition: An issued version of a scheme defining workflow values and permitted transitions.
concepts.rationale: Retain the comparison boundary. Riskium WorkflowSchemeVersion is an issued transition specification; concept-scheme aggregation or a revision qualification does not define its transitions or authorization rules.
concepts.boundary: Do not infer executable workflow rules from a concept aggregation or version lineage.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported reinspection of selected primary passages and unchanged authored/local structural context; not an independent expert judgment.

concepts.title: Workflow Assignment
concepts.authored_definition: A temporally bounded situation in which a managed record revision has an assigned workflow state under an identified scheme version; the statement documenting this situation is separate.
concepts.rationale: Replace the scoped absence label with a contrast. Riskium WorkflowAssignment is a timed record-state situation under a scheme version, rather than an activity-function description.
concepts.boundary: The statement documenting an assignment is distinct from the assignment situation.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported reinspection of selected primary passages and unchanged authored/local structural context; not an independent expert judgment.

concepts.title: Observation Activity
concepts.authored_definition: An activity that observes a stated feature of a subject using a declared procedure and temporal context.
concepts.rationale: Retain the procedure/feature/value observation comparison. Riskium keeps its stated subject, procedure and temporal context without automatically importing every source restriction.
concepts.boundary: An observation report is information about an activity; the comparison does not establish all-profile equivalence.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported reinspection of selected primary passages and unchanged authored/local structural context; not an independent expert judgment.

boundaries.normative_crosswalks: Exact normative adoption remains #78. This packet uses selected public primary passages, not licensed ISO/PRINCE2/ISACA full text.
boundaries.semantic_review: Existing #23 is unchanged; documentary reuse is not independent semantic acceptance.
boundaries.review_scope: Unchanged concept records and direct associations/generalizations were rechecked. This is not a proof that every indirect/global semantic context is unchanged.
boundaries.sosa_scope: Only the Observation definition is used; source displays may combine SOSA with stronger SSN restrictions. No cardinality or restriction is imported into Riskium.
boundaries.deployment_scope: Seventeen previews remain planning artifacts. Full component qualification and actual repository/Wiki/Pages publication/readback are later gates.
